author: packs
description: Community forums (G13-T1): categories, threads, posts with an accepted answer, votes and ideas with their statuses, and a moderation queue: a new post, thread or idea holding a link or a blocked term waits for a moderator. The Community Moderator and Community Viewer roles ship with it.
name: community

definition.name: Community: Moderation Queue
definition.sql: SELECT id, thread_ref, author_name, created_at FROM forum_post WHERE moderation_status = 'pending' AND is_active IS NOT FALSE ORDER BY created_at

definition.description: A new item with a link or a blocked term waits for a moderator instead of being published. Add your own blocked terms to the condition.
